title: Cat
text: The cat is a small furry animal. Cats are often kept as pets and they hunt mice.

opening_text: The dog is a domesticated animal.
title: Dog
text: The dog is a domesticated animal. It is often called man's best friend, and it "barks".

title: Café
text: A café is a place that sells coffee and light meals. The word comes from French.

title: Sun
text:
The Sun is the star at the centre of the Solar System.
It gives light and heat to the planets.	It is mostly hydrogen.
